record.reason: TriAlign is an offline multi-agent reinforcement-learning objective for personalized LLM truth consistency/fairness. The paper evaluates truthfulness and personalization, not distributed-training memory, throughput, or inference serving; the DeepSpeed lineage label does not correspond to a systems contribution.
record.title: TriAlign: Towards Universal Truth Consistency in Personalized LLM Alignment
